name: backup-restore
description: Complete backup and restore solution with DEFCON-style audit logging, SHA-256 verification proofs, automated scheduling, and selective component restore. Never lose your AI configurations, memories, or workflows again.
shortDescription: Backup, restore, and migrate your entire QuoxCORE installation.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Full system backups with one click
DEFCON-style audit logging for all operations
Dry-run mode for safe restore previews
Automated backup scheduling (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly)

fullBackup.name: Full Backup
fullBackup.description: Backup all 11 critical components including databases, memory, uploads, workflows, and configurations.

selectiveBackup.name: Selective Backup
selectiveBackup.description: Choose specific components to backup - databases, uploads, n8n workflows, agent configs, and more.

verification.name: SHA-256 Verification
verification.description: Cryptographic proofs ensure backup integrity. Verify archives haven't been tampered with or corrupted.

dryRunRestore.name: Dry-Run Restore
dryRunRestore.description: Preview what a restore will do before committing changes. Safe simulation mode for testing.

scheduling.name: Automated Scheduling
scheduling.description: Configure recurring backups - hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly with retention policies.

auditLogging.name: DEFCON Audit Logging
auditLogging.description: Military-style audit trail with risk levels (GREEN→RED) for all backup and restore operations.

notifications.name: Inbox Notifications
notifications.description: Receive alerts via inbox when backups complete or fail. Integrates with email, Slack, Telegram.

migration.name: Migration Support
migration.description: Move your entire QuoxCORE installation to a new server with full data preservation.
